title: Fire Plume Ridge

Fire Plume Ridge is the volcano subzone in the middle of [[Un'Goro Crater]]. Lava flows down the sides of the mountain, where [[fire elemental|fire elementals]] of lvl 51-54 can be found. A mighty fire elemental, [[Blazerunner]], lives at its peak.  During [[Elemental Invasions]], more fire elementals and [[Baron Charr]] appear here.  

This area is plentiful in [[Mountain Silversage]] and [[Thorium]] veins, and is also a favored spot for farming [[Essence of Fire]].

The hottest place in the ridge is apparently 428,000 degrees Kraklenheit. (Krakle' Thermometer says: Holy Krakle! The temperature is 428,000 degrees Kraklenheit!)
